Description (SPA): Identificador canonico del concurso electoral dentro del warehouse. Permite distinguir el mismo tipo de mesa/casilla entre ciclos y oficinas distintas.
Description (ENG): Canonical election-contest identifier inside the warehouse. It distinguishes the same polling-station/casilla structure across years and offices.
Values / Domain: Examples: PRE_1994, PRE_2000, DIP_MR_2000, DIP_MR_2009, SEN_MR_2006, DIP_MR_2021, PRE_2024. MIN_2025, TDJ_2025, TEPJF_SS_2025, TEPJF_SR_2025, TCCA_2025, JD_2025.
Notes: Inserted from ELECTION_META in electoral/ingest.py. Also used as the partition/join key in facts and casillas. 19 contests: PRE/DIP_MR/SEN_MR for 2000, 2006, 2012, 2018, 2024; PRE only for 1994; DIP_MR for 2009, 2015, and 2021. Only MR (first-past-the-post) seats are loaded for DIP/SEN; RP is not modeled as a separate vote contest. See table_dictionaries/README.md for the full coverage matrix. Plus 6 contests (MIN_2025, TDJ_2025, TEPJF_SS_2025, TEPJF_SR_2025, TCCA_2025, JD_2025) for the 2025 judicial election, ingested separately by ingest_judicial_election() rather than the SCHEMA_MAP-driven ingest_election() path -- see the dictionary README's 2025 Judicial Election section.

Description (SPA): Año calendario de la eleccion federal.
Description (ENG): Calendar year of the federal election.
Notes: This is the election year, not the ingestion year.

Description (SPA): Tipo de eleccion normalizado a una clave corta de oficina o camara.
Description (ENG): Normalized short key for the election office or chamber.
Notes: Values come from pipeline metadata and are intentionally compact for filtering. JUD covers all six 2025 judicial races; see seat_method for how they differ from each other.

Description (SPA): Camara legislativa asociada al concurso, cuando aplica.
Description (ENG): Legislative chamber associated with the contest, when applicable.
Notes: Presidential elections have NULL because they are executive contests, not chamber contests.

Description (SPA): Metodo de eleccion o asignacion representado por el concurso cargado.
Description (ENG): Election or allocation method represented by the loaded contest.
Notes: The ingested additions are direct presidential contests, first-past-the-post/MR-style legislative contests, or (for the 2025 judicial election) national_at_large/regional_at_large/multi_winner_district judicial races -- see the dictionary README's 2025 Judicial Election section for what each means.

Description (SPA): Numero de cargos o escanos representados por el concurso segun la metadata del pipeline.
Description (ENG): Number of offices or seats represented by the contest according to pipeline metadata.
Values / Domain: 1 for presidential; 300 for deputies MR-style loads; 96 for senate MR-style loads. 9 for SCJN ministers; 5 for the Tribunal de Disciplina Judicial; 2 for TEPJF Sala Superior; 15 for TEPJF Salas Regionales; 464 for circuit magistrates; 386 for district judges.
Notes: Metadata field; it is not computed from casilla-level results.

Description (SPA): Duracion legal del cargo en años.
Values / Domain: 3 or 6 for federal legislative/presidential contests; 6, 8, or 12 for the 2025 judicial election (see Notes).
Notes: Used for descriptive metadata and downstream filtering. The 2025 judicial cohort's term_years reflects a one-off transition rule, not the reform's steady-state term: TDJ and TEPJF (Sala Superior and Salas Regionales) are 6, SCJN ministers are 12, and circuit magistrates/district judges are 8 for this cohort only (9 is the steady-state term starting with the next cohort).

Description (SPA): Numero de actas esperadas para la carrera, segun la publicacion oficial del INE.
Description (ENG): Number of actas expected for the race, per INE's official publication.
Values / Domain: Positive integer, or NULL for pre-2025 federal contests.
Notes: Judicial-election only; captured from the source file's own summary header rather than reconstructed from casillas.

Description (SPA): Numero de actas efectivamente computadas al momento del corte.
Description (ENG): Number of actas actually counted as of the cutoff.
Values / Domain: Positive integer, or NULL for pre-2025 federal contests.
Notes: Judicial-election only. 100% for all six 2025 races in the current snapshot.

Description (SPA): Porcentaje de actas computadas respecto de las esperadas.
Description (ENG): Percentage of actas counted relative to those expected.
Values / Domain: 0-100, or NULL for pre-2025 federal contests.
Notes: Judicial-election only; as published, not recomputed.

Description (SPA): Suma de lista nominal de las casillas cuyas actas ya fueron computadas.
Description (ENG): Sum of the nominal voter list for casillas whose actas have already been counted.
Values / Domain: Positive integer, or NULL for pre-2025 federal contests.

Description (SPA): Total nacional de personas que votaron en la carrera, segun el sistema de computos.
Description (ENG): National total of people who voted in the race, per the counting system.
Values / Domain: Positive integer, or NULL for pre-2025 federal contests.
Notes: Judicial-election only; denominator-independent turnout count as published by INE.

Description (SPA): Porcentaje de participacion ciudadana oficial para la carrera.
Description (ENG): Official citizen-participation percentage for the race.
Values / Domain: 0-100, or NULL for pre-2025 federal contests.
Notes: Judicial-election only. Ranges 12.93-13.02 across the six 2025 races -- INE's headline figure for the election's record-low turnout.

Description (SPA): Total nacional de votos emitidos en la carrera (incluye nulos), segun el sistema de computos.
Description (ENG): National total of votes cast in the race (nulls included), per the counting system.
Values / Domain: Positive integer, or NULL for pre-2025 federal contests.
Notes: Judicial-election only; as published, not recomputed from fact_judicial_casilla_vote.

Description (SPA): Marca de tiempo de insercion generada por SQLite.
Notes: Warehouse-only field; not present in clean parquet inputs.
